executive_summary: Diseñado un observador de la búsqueda real y un ejecutor local aislado para medir relevancia sin modificar el ranking ni los contratos públicos.
risks: La ejecución externa queda condicionada a canonicalizar DocuTests2 y resolver permisos y autoridad nativa; no se han solicitado ni utilizado aquí.
Las mediciones requieren un índice preparado sin escritores activos, un snapshot estable y el modelo preparado; la falta de requisitos debe detener esa medición.
La paridad exacta del observador y la ausencia de contaminación se demostrarán mediante TDD y gates reales posteriores; este diseño no constituye evidencia experimental.
detailed_report:
Design covers production-owned per-attempt tracing including filter retries, isolated database copies, reviewed stable alternative chunk labels, independent k=5/k=10 calls, provenance and semantic result identities, distinct fallback diagnostics, and separate synthetic versus real gates. The existing 22-case Spanish evaluator is unchanged. Only design.md and this raw result were created; no tasks, implementation, tests, builds, model initialization, external mutation or delivery actions occurred. OpenSpec remains authoritative; Engram contains only a decision summary. Next phase is advisory and awaits interactive approval.

## Key Learnings

1. SearchDocuments may retry after removing impossible filters, so traces must retain every attempt.
2. EvaluateSearch uses three-times-k chunk retrieval and cannot substitute for exact production top-five measurements.
3. Opening the SQLite store performs schema initialization, so measurement runs should open an isolated database copy.
